Iterative linear solvers (jax.scipy.sparse.linalg)

Source: R/scipy_linalg.R
scipy_sparse_linalg.Rd

Ports of jax.scipy.sparse.linalg.cg, bicgstab and gmres. The linear operator A is a matrix or a function computing A %*% x for a pytree x; gradients are computed by implicit differentiation (lax_custom_linear_solve()). cg and bicgstab return list(x, NULL) (no convergence information, as in JAX); gmres returns list(x, info) where info is -1 if the solution contains NaN and 0 otherwise.

Usage

scipy_sparse_linalg_cg(
  A,
  b,
  x0 = NULL,
  tol = 1e-05,
  atol = 0,
  maxiter = NULL,
  M = NULL
)

scipy_sparse_linalg_bicgstab(
  A,
  b,
  x0 = NULL,
  tol = 1e-05,
  atol = 0,
  maxiter = NULL,
  M = NULL
)

scipy_sparse_linalg_gmres(
  A,
  b,
  x0 = NULL,
  tol = 1e-05,
  atol = 0,
  restart = 20L,
  maxiter = NULL,
  M = NULL,
  solve_method = "batched"
)

Arguments

A

Square matrix or linear function.

b

Right hand side (array or pytree).

x0

Starting guess (default zeros).

tol, atol

Relative and absolute tolerances: the iteration stops when norm(residual) <= max(tol * norm(b), atol).

maxiter

Maximum number of iterations (default 10 * size(b)).

M

Preconditioner (matrix or function approximating the inverse of A).

restart

Size of the Krylov subspace between restarts (gmres).

solve_method

"batched" or "incremental" (gmres).

Value

list(x, info).
